Design study for gameplay · not a construction or life-safety plan

A working drawing, ready to change

Start in Preview mode: drag to pan and pinch to zoom on touch screens. Press Edit to change rooms. Click a room to select it. Drag its interior to move it; drag the orange corner to resize. Use the inspector for exact metric dimensions and names.

Doors connect two rooms along their shared wall. When rooms move apart, the door is flagged and hidden, rather than left floating. Fix the adjacency or reconnect the door.

Aligned stairs and freight shafts are locked in the starting plan. Stair treads in plan are symbolic. 3D geometry exports contain metric flights, elevations, wall segments, door openings and voids for the Blender blockout. Corridors are editable rooms too. Plan checks flag overlaps, detached doors and rooms without a route to a floor entrance.

Undo / redo: Ctrl or ⌘ Z / Shift Z. Arrow keys move a selected room 0.5 m. SVG export produces editable vector linework for Figma; JSON preserves the complete editable model.

Warm wood in lived-in spaces, pale concrete circulation, blue-grey technical rooms. V5 uses a compact broken perimeter around a 10 m open-sky court. Operations combines control, radio/radar, maps and support as zones in one room. Open L-shaped links retain broken sightlines without corridor-to-corridor doors. Garage and dirty rooms are 1.2 m below research, with an explicit eight-step return to clean transfer. V1–V4 and their saved device edits remain separate. The field store has only an outside entrance. Blank space is exterior or unexcavated rock.
